scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck:release && pnpm -r --filter "!@workspace/mockup-sandbox" --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:release: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter "!@workspace/mockup-sandbox" --if-present run typecheck

//scripts.typecheck: Full sweep, including the mockup-sandbox scratch workspace. This is what CI runs — sandbox breakage should still be visible.
//scripts.typecheck:release: Shippable projects only. Used by `build` so a scratch workspace can never block a production deploy.
//scripts.build: Builds everything that ships. mockup-sandbox is private, deploys nowhere, and is not referenced by .replit.
